integrity: Exact finite graph-orbit recurrence, an independent complete stable-face enumeration, all 2304 actions, and exact 40-class character inner products reproduced by accompanying Python code.
scientific_limitations: Finite 32-vertex categorical-product graph and specified coordinate symmetry only; rational, not integral, irreducible decomposition. title: Multiplicity-free rational homology under the natural symmetries of \(K_2\times K_4\times K_4\)
